reviews.review:
Do you like Warhammer 40k?
Do you like killing aliens and demons?
Do you like third-person run and gun games?
Do you want to fight for the glory of the God Emperor?

If you answered yes to these questions, buy the game. If you answered no to the last one......DIE HERETIC!

I started this game going in blind.
I never really played and Warhammer 40k game.
So the WH universe for me is new.
That said....

I did like the story and mainly the combat for me was fun!
There was some diverse combat action areas in the game which really kept the game fresh.
I also really like the art style.

Pro's

Art style
Combat is diverse and fun.

Con's

They really should of made a DLC ( considering the end )
End was weak, not by story but by the choice how they decided to do the final fight.

Not bad. Melee combat is a bit generic. I was quite excited to unlock each upgrade or new weapon though, getting to play with a lot of the weapons Marines are famous for. Decent story also, nothing revolutionary, but an acceptable 40k story. Couple of areas were problematic though. If you have the heaviest melee weapon, you CANNOT use your heavier guns. So some sections of the game were agonising as I had to pick off flying tanky enemies with nothing but a pistol. Also a bit buggy in areas, a couple of times I fell through a wall performing an execute.

So yeah, it's nothing ground breaking, but still a pretty fun 40k game. Best bit is definitely flying around on a jetpack >:)

Great game. Fun combat - really feels like you're a giant hulking Space Marine, and the enemies/NPCs are beautifully brought to life. Great fun for anyone I would think, but for fans of the universe, it is especially gratifying to get up close and personal with a lot of your favorite combatants.

Nice (if slightly contrived feeling) progressing of skills and weapons throughout the game and the art direction is superb. The level design is great, and the battles are huge and satisfying. Combat may not be as intricate as some other similar games, but it's satisfying and suitably challenging.

Only real con is that exploration is not really rewarded (and when you have the assault pack, just flying around is a lot of fun). There are lots of nooks and crannies throughout the levels, but generally they are pretty empty. Sticking to the main line of the game will keep you plenty busy and entertained, but it feels like they could have filled in some of the auxilliary space a little more.

I really hope they end up making a sequel to this. It would be awesome to see some more of the universe's awesome inhabitants brought to life, and I would definitely purchase day 1. Again, for fans of the WH40K universe, this is a must have.
